name: Suntak Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Suntak Technology Co.,Ltd. research and development, production, and sells printed circuit boards in China and internationally. The company offers mobile phone board; computer and laptop motherboard, GPU, and touchpad; EPS, OBC, DI5-LGA, DCU, new energy electric drive MCU, camera module, central entertainment system, and VW MQB; transceiver, switch mainboard, communication base station, antenna, and optical module; server mainboard, computing mainboard, and AI server; and photovoltaic inverter, industrial control, and industrial control machine.
